scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Ah...
The pinnacle
of craftsmanship.
That's the work of
a MasterSmith.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
啊...
工艺的巅峰。
这就是神工匠的作品。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Once you're the
the best of the best,
you begin forging with
the goal of discovering
new and better ways of
crafting...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
当你成为最顶尖的工匠后，
你便开始以发现
更崭新、更卓越的锻造方式
为目标...

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
The time has come!
Our world needs brave,
hard-working adventurers
like you...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
时候到了！
我们的世界需要
像你这样勇敢、
勤勉的冒险者...

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Would you like to
become a MasterSmith?
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你想成为神工匠吗？

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
准备好了的话，
随时欢迎回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回来之前，
用完你剩余的所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Congratulations!
As a MasterSmith,
I hope you will forge
a path towards a brighter
future for Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜！
作为神工匠，
我希望你能锻造出一条
通往米德加尔特
更光明未来的道路。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
欢迎来到
英灵殿，
荣耀之厅。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
请在这里
随意休息。
向勇士们致敬！
